title: docs(blog): link the English deck PDF from the end of 'The Ontology Is the Software'
body:
Fixes #22263
Clause-②: no

One paragraph added at the end of `content/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx`, after *Further reading*: an *As a talk* note linking the English deck, "The Ontology Is the Software — How a large model reads an enterprise", as a PDF. Nothing else on the page changes.

## Link form

Absolute, https://objectstack.ai/decks/the-ontology-is-the-software.pdf, not root-relative. The Check Documentation Links lane runs lychee `--offline` with `--root-dir` at `content/` (see `.github/workflows/check-links.yml`), so `/decks/...` would resolve to `content/decks/...` and fail, while an http(s) link is excluded by `--offline`. The file is served from `apps/docs/public/decks/` by PR #22254, ahead of this one in the merge queue.

## Gates (head 8e821262, exit codes captured per command)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack content/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx` derives 15 commands; all 15 exit 0: check-ci-filter-parity, check-closing-keyword-parity (and `--self-test`), check-comment-mask-corpus, check-doc-frontmatter (and `--self-test`), the lint package's check:doc-formula-expressions, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:doc-anchors, check:doc-authoring, check:driver-memory-census, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:refd-timer-probe, check:watch-hint-literal. The formula-expressions gate first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured) in the fresh worktree; it exited 0 after `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/lint..." build`.

## Checks

- Docs-only: one file under `content/blog/`. No `packages/**`, `apps/docs/**`, README or generated ledger. Nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.
- No model identifier in the diff, the commit or this body.
- Seat-executed under the maintainer's instruction quoted on the card, and landed through the merge queue on that instruction.
